BiblicalUsage: Isaiah says that even when favour is shown to the wicked, he will not learn righteousness — in the land of uprightness he will deal unjustly. The word is that unjust dealing, a life lived crooked on purpose.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe kindness alone never straightens a heart that refuses to learn; only repentance does.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
